presentation.summary: Sync Silo watch activity, lists, ratings, and dropped shows with Trakt.
presentation.description_markdown: Imports watched movies and episodes, resume progress, favorites, the watchlist, movie and show ratings, and dropped shows from Trakt. Exports completed plays, unwatched titles, favorites, watchlist changes, ratings, and dropped shows, and forwards live playback start, pause, and stop events.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin. Each Silo profile connects its own Trakt account from its watch-provider settings: click Connect, open https://trakt.tv/activate, and enter the code shown. No Trakt app setup is needed; the plugin ships with a public client. To use your own app, create one at https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications with the redirect URI `urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob`, then enter its client ID and secret below.

presentation.summary: Recognize mainstream comics by their embedded ComicInfo.xml and enrich series and issues with metadata, creators, and publication details.
presentation.description_markdown: Reads the ComicInfo.xml file embedded in CBZ/CBR archives (as defined by the Anansi Project) and maps its fields onto Silo metadata: title, series, number, count, volume, summary, creators, publisher, genres, tags, characters, teams, locations, age rating, and page info.
presentation.setup_markdown:
Install the plugin, then add ComicInfo Metadata to a comic library's provider chain. Embedded ComicInfo.xml is read with no extra setup. Two optional online sources can be enabled:

**ComicVine** — set `comicvine_api_key` to a free API key from https://comicvine.gamespot.com/api/.

**Grand Comics Database (GCD)** — the plugin reads the official SQLite dump:
1. Create a free account at https://www.comics.org and sign in.
2. Open https://www.comics.org/download/, choose **Private Use**, and copy the SQLite dump link.
3. Paste that link into `gcd_dump_url`.
4. Open the browser DevTools, go to **Network**, reload any comics.org page, open the request headers, and copy the value of the **`sessionid`** cookie. Paste it into `gcd_dump_cookie` as `sessionid=<value>`. If the download returns 403 (Cloudflare), paste the whole Cookie header instead, including `cf_clearance` and `csrftoken`.
5. Set `gcd_dump_path` to where the dump should be saved (for example `/config/gcd.db`) and `gcd_refresh_hours` to how often to refresh it.

The dump is about 6 GB. The cookie is stored encrypted by Silo.

capabilities.description: Reads embedded ComicInfo.xml from mainstream comic archives to populate metadata, creators, and publication details.

presentation.summary: Match podcast shows against the Apple Podcasts directory and fill in the description, publisher, genre, language, and square cover art.
presentation.description_markdown: Reads the Apple Podcasts directory over Apple's public JSON API and each show's own RSS feed. Search returns directory matches by show name. Detail fills the show description, publisher, genres, language, first and latest episode dates, and an explicit flag. Artwork is served through an image resolver, so the shown poster is Apple's cover at whatever size Silo asks for instead of a low-resolution copy.
presentation.setup_markdown:
Install the plugin, then add **Apple Podcasts** to a podcast library's metadata provider chain. No account or API key is needed: the directory and the feeds are public.

**Storefront** — set `country` to the two-letter Apple storefront to search (default `us`). A show carried only in one storefront is found only there.

Artwork comes from Apple's image service at the size Silo requests, so nothing is stored locally beyond Silo's own artwork cache.

capabilities.description: Matches podcast shows to the Apple Podcasts directory and enriches them from each show's RSS feed.
Resolves apple-podcasts:// artwork paths to Apple's podcast cover images at the requested size.

global_config_schema.title: Apple storefront
global_config_schema.description: Two-letter storefront to search, for example us, gb, de, bg. Default us.
